Subject: Nebula Systems — technical demo readiness & calendar consolidation

Hi Alex / Priya / team,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — excited to move to a focused technical demo with our Solutions Engineering (Ben) and your customer engineering and procurement/security partners. To make the session efficient for all stakeholders, proposed agenda:
- 0–10m: quick introductions + success metrics (AE)
- 10–40m: SE-led architecture & performance walkthrough (inference latency, KV cache behavior, VPC/private deployment options)
- 40–55m: security & compliance Qs (SOC 2, data residency, audit logs)
- 55–60m: next steps / procurement checklist

Proposed windows next week (PST):
- Wed, Jun 16 — 10:00–11:00am
- Thu, Jun 17 — 8:30–9:30am or 1:30–2:30pm

Ben is cc’d for SE availability and technical asks. I’ve attached a short deck and the latest SOW draft to help procurement review before the call. If there are specific perf metrics or a test dataset you want us to run ahead of time, please flag them and Ben can prepare.

Attachments: [redwood-demo-slide-deck.pdf], [sow-draft-v0.2.docx]

Thanks — if we can lock a slot and who will attend from Security/Procurement, I’ll send calendar invite + recording permission.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Thanks Marissa. Quick availability note: I’m booked Tue morning and prefer Wed 10–11am PST as suggested. I’ll run through:
- architecture: host modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private/VPC) and routing policies
- performance: sample latency numbers, batching and KV-cache tradeoffs; will show a short live trace
- security: high-level SOC 2 artifacts and where to find audit logs (we’ll keep this to the first 15–20m for the Security folks)

Action items for Alex / Priya: can you share a small representative request pattern (token lengths / concurrency) or a sample CSV we can use to reproduce latency? If you can’t share data, we can demo with a synthetic workload but results will differ.

I’ll prepare a short perf run and attach the trace + brief notes post-call.
